title: QUIC RFC 9000 ECN Packet-Number-Space Separation Work Item

- Add canonical x_test_refs and focused architecture/work-item/verification artifacts for REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S13P4P1-0006.
- Regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, validate SpecTrace JSON, run focused and full Release verification, and keep ECN validation and endpoint interop claims out of scope.
